notice.tun: TUN mode may prompt for administrator rights

rules.killswitch-desc: Block all traffic when the proxy is down
rules.reset-servers-desc: Remove every server. Rules and settings stay.
rules.title: Routing & rules

auto_failover.description: When the health check fails three times in a row, connect to the fastest reachable server
auto_failover.label: Auto-failover

auto_start.description: Connect the active server automatically when the plugin loads
auto_start.label: Auto-connect on start

backend_python.description: Python 3 executable with the backend dependencies installed
backend_python.label: Backend Python

control_port.description: Localhost port for the backend HTTP control API
control_port.label: Control port

geoip_country.description: Look up each server's country by IP to show its flag. Sends the server address to api.country.is.
geoip_country.label: Detect server country

health_interval.description: Seconds between health checks of the connected server
health_interval.label: Health check interval (s)

ping_concurrency.description: How many servers are pinged in parallel by "Ping all"
ping_concurrency.label: Ping concurrency

ping_count.description: Samples per health check (more samples = steadier jitter, slower)
ping_count.label: Ping samples

ping_method.description: "TCP" checks reachability of every server (works before connecting). "HTTP" sends a real request through the tunnel, which only measures the connected server.
ping_method.label: Ping method

ping_url.description: URL requested by the HTTP ping method
ping_url.label: Ping URL
